drills.title: Largest sum of k consecutive numbers
drills.instructions:
### Build
Implement `maxWindowSum(values, k)`: the largest sum of any `k` consecutive numbers in `values`.

### Rules
- Return `null` when `k` is not a positive integer or is larger than `values.length`.
- Visit each number a constant number of times: slide the window instead of re-adding it.

### Done
Run the tests; all of them pass.
